notes.title: Wisps of the Elements has a release trailer
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]I’m excited to share that [b]Wisps of the Elements[/b] is officially subscribed to [b]Steam Next Fest (October)[/b] 🎉
The full release will follow on [b]October 24th[/b], and the demo will remain available after launch.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 What’s new in today’s update?[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed: crystal golem instructions overlapping the battle board, which blocked progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed: spell descriptions overflowing the screen in the [b]Pick a Spell[/b] panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance (hard to reproduce since only one player reported major slowdowns—if you’re affected, please [url="https://discord.gg/X56nUAzqMQ"]reach out on Discord[/url] 🙏).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI on small screens.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📅 Roadmap to release[/h3][list][*][p]Addressing reported issues (the list is small, so I’ve got time for [url="https://discord.gg/X56nUAzqMQ"]new feedback[/url] 🙏).[/p][/*][*][p]Marketing: this is my first game, and I’m working on better ways to reach my target audience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 After release[/h3][list][*][p]Possible [b]Hard Mode[/b], if the game feels too easy (though surprisingly few players have beaten the final boss so far).[/p][/*][*][p]New spells and enemy updates to keep things fresh.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a [b]Wizard’s Challenge[/b] to explain enemy AI, for players seeking to optimize their expeditions the best they can.[/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility improvements to reach more players.[/p][/*][*][p]Various design and QoL updates.[/p][/*][/list]
